# Drew Clark

> Portfolio of Drew Clark, a software engineer. It presents three projects and has a chat that answers questions about each project from its current source code on GitHub.

## Projects

- [AI Platform Trainer](https://github.com/life423/ai-platform-trainer): A 2D platformer game featuring AI-driven enemy behavior built with Python and Pygame.
- [Cryptography Toolkit with AI Analysis](https://github.com/life423/polyalphabetic-and-caesar_cipher): A comprehensive encryption application implementing Caesar and Polyalphabetic ciphers with AI-powered cryptanalysis capabilities.
- [Ascend-Avoid](https://ascend.drewclark.io): A shared-arena multiplayer browser game: open the page and you're in, hopping for gems against people and bots in real time. Source: https://github.com/life423/ascend-avoid

## About this site

- [Source code](https://github.com/life423/drewclark.io-portfolio): React and Vite frontend, Express API, and an OpenAI chat that searches the project repos with MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
- Contact: drew@drewclark.io
